Above the gap the tunnelling current through the junction is
\begin{equation}
I(V) = G_N\sqrt{V^2-\Delta^2} ,
\label{eq:iv}
\end{equation}
with normal-state conductance $G_N>0$. The characteristic is linear,
\begin{equation}
I(2V) = 2\,I(V) .
\label{eq:lin}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
